combo_label: Weather & Seasons × Musical Instruments × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: The blow a shipping forecast warns of, strong enough to keep the ferries in port.
Hargreaves' vast pink fellow who eats the lot and eyes up your plate too
Blue cloud of a Hargreaves fellow who whisks a boy off to far lands; a waking fancy
Broad rosewood bars over long tubes, mellower and deeper than the xylophone
Droning Highland set fed by air squeezed from a sack under the elbow
Blue star-shaped Hargreaves chap from chilly Coldland; one sudden red-nosed achoo
Yellow Little Miss who brings smiles to gloomy Miseryland; warmth from above
Hanging bronze circle struck once and left to shiver for an age
Silvery crystal coat left on windscreens after a cold, clear night.
Cupped in both palms and slid along the lips, sounding on blow and on draw
Silent white fall that hushes streets and closes schools.
Half-melted mix, neither proper flakes nor plain drops, stinging your face.
